newsitem.title: CHINA: Strong aftershock shakes west China, some damage.
newsitem.headline: Strong aftershock shakes west China, some damage.

text.p: A strong aftershock measuring 5.2 on the Richter scale jolted China's northwestern Xinjiang region on Wednesday, causing more damage in an area where 50 people were killed in a tremor earlier this month.
The tremor rocked the Jiashi district at 4.20 p.m. (0620 GMT) on Wednesday, flattening houses and sheds and killing livestock, the official Xinhua news agency said.
It was the 19th aftershock measuring more than 4.0 on the Richter scale to rock Jiashi since an earthquake of 6.4 magnitude caused widespread damage on January 21, Xinhua said.
The number of casualties from the latest aftershock had yet to be determined, Xinhua said.
